services.name: 2 Hour Party for up to 20 guests

blurb: Guests can enjoy Candlepin Bowling, a New England game known for being fun and challenging. The facility offers bumpers for children at no extra cost and instruction for first-time bowlers upon request. Birthday parties for up to 20 guests include bowling lanes, ice cream cake, bowling shoes, and a party area with a playlist feature.
